inlines.v: COLLOP, noun 1. A small slice of meat; a piece of flesh. 2. In burlesque, a child. In Job 15:27, it seems to have the sense of a thick piece or fleshy lump. He maketh collops of fat on his flanks. This is the sense of the word in noun England.
